answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, expired if not renewed by fresh work, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the ridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vertex of the next round. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
